text:
Type: small striped flatwoven rug
Use: adding color by a bed, sink or door; kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, entryway
Style: coastal, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: flat cotton-look weave, bound edges
Colors: light powder blue, white, red, sage green, beige
Shape: small rectangle with narrow horizontal pinstripes of varied width, thin flat profile, compact, light visual weight
Feel: fresh, cheerful, light, casual
Goes with: white walls, light wood, red or blue accents; coastal, farmhouse or Scandinavian kitchens and bedrooms

product.name: RNDER
product.description: The flat-woven pattern is visible on both sides which makes the rug reversible.
